description: List the physical assessments the trainer registered in MFIT for one or many students, newest first. Each item has the assessment id, date, kind (anthropometric protocol or bioimpedance), protocol name, and the main numbers as recorded in MFIT: weight, body fat %, BMI, lean and fat mass. Values are the data entered by the professional and the figures MFIT computed from them; this tool does not interpret them. Use mfit_get_physical_assessment with an id for every measure and the change since the previous assessment.
name: mfit_list_physical_assessments
